title: By-election in Datia Constituency: A Contest for Local Representation
summary: A by-election is being held in the Datia constituency of Madhya Pradesh, India. The contest is between two candidates: a BJP candidate named Ashutosh and an independent candidate. The by-election was triggered due to the resignation of the previous MLA. The outcome of the election will determine who represents the constituency in the state legislature.
summary_points: A by-election is being held in the Datia constituency of Madhya Pradesh, India.
The contest is between two candidates: a BJP candidate named Ashutosh and an independent candidate.
The by-election was triggered due to the resignation of the previous MLA.
The outcome of the election will determine who represents the constituency in the state legislature.
The by-election is seen as a test of local strength for both parties.
